system.description: You exude an aura of holiness: your voice carries like an angel's and an inner light seems to radiate from you. Others venerate you, and even those who mean you harm find it hard to act against you. The true source of this blessing is unknown, but observers believe God has anointed you in some manner. Blessed does not confer the benefits of True Faith, but it does convey the same benefits as Majesty (Presence, Level Five) among the character's flock, so long as she does nothing to break the divine perception they hold of her.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Three: Madmen
